macros.name: mobFormPresets
macros.doc: \mobFormPresets is used to set the appearance of the buttons when the useforms option is taken.

macros.name: mobPrint
macros.doc: \mobPrint sets the text of the print link and the button caption if its a push button.

macros.name: mobPrintTip
macros.doc: \mobPrintTip is the tool tip when there’s a button for Print.

macros.name: mobToggleCols
macros.doc: \mobToggleCols sets the text for the toggle link and the button caption if its a push button.

macros.name: mobToggleColsTip
macros.doc: \mobToggleColsTip is the tool tip for the toggle button.

macros.name: scalefiguresOff
macros.doc: The commands \scalefiguresOn and \scalefiguresOff are a convenient way to turn the scaling of figures on and off.
